adaptation_measures: Avoid strenuous field operations during peak heat hours.
Monitor flowering/tasseling crops for heat stress and maintain soil moisture.

texts.bulletin: HIGH HEAT STRESS — Baggao: Avoid prolonged field work from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Ensure adequate hydration for farm workers. Monitor heat-sensitive crops (vegetables, high-value crops). Reschedule spraying and transplanting to early morning hours. Check livestock ventilation and water supply.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: High heat in Baggao. Avoid farm work 10AM-2PM. Stay hydrated.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS ADVISORY — Baggao
High heat conditions: schedule farm work early morning or late afternoon.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Santo Niño: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Santo Niño. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Santo Niño
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.
texts.facebook:
🌡️ HEAT DANGER ALERT — Santo Niño

Mapanganib na init ngayon!
⛔ Huwag magtrabaho sa bukid mula 9AM–4PM
💧 Uminom ng maraming tubig
🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Naguilian: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Naguilian. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Naguilian
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.
texts.facebook:
🌡️ HEAT DANGER ALERT — Naguilian

Mapanganib na init ngayon!
⛔ Huwag magtrabaho sa bukid mula 9AM–4PM
💧 Uminom ng maraming tubig
🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley
